タイトル: I used to like it in the beginning

良い点: Easy to use, efficient in centralising all reservations, no issues during busy season.

タイトル: Could not get it to work in £ and packages broke every day
投稿者: Mark 英国のDirector レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Could not get it to work in £ and packages broke every day"
良い点: The booking system looked good and were were told it would support package deals e..g. two activities at a discount.
改善点: The booking system could not do the most basic addition. If someone selected a £30 activity the total came out at £35.64. Regoindo spent weeks trying to make it work without success. Package deals were setup, but kept displaying that they were fully booked. We got it fixed then it broke again, day after day after day. Reports from Regiondo are in Excel in german format with a comma in place of a decimal point, so a UK version of Excel cannot make sense of it.

改善点: I need to be able to let the customer choose the language of the experience is buying, and at the moment that the customer book an experience in English on X day at Y hour, on X day at Y hour only the English option remains active. To have that i had to make 2 differnt experiences in regiondo, and i had to separe and create different pages on my website to be sure to let the people book the experience in the language they prefer. Would be nice to let us personalize more gift vouchers. Oh, and invoices are very hard to understand.

タイトル: Works well but pricey for a larger business
投稿者: Matyas ハンガリーのOnline Business Director (former) レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Works well but pricey for a larger business"
良い点: It has tons of integrations with OTA's and many additional features. Their support and the content they publish are also great.
改善点: Taking a percentage fee after each booking with no maximum amount per month is honestly not something I can agree on in principle, especially considering that in our plan we paid around 3.5% after every booking done through our own website, plus a fixed fee of EUR .50 per each ticket sold, plus monthly fee, plus cancellation fees sometimes, plus there was even a fee for receiving bookings from OTA's -- the total of this was around 5 to 7 percent of our total revenue that we paid in fees per month. This may be fine for a small business just starting out with yearly online bookings under 50k, but it amounts to a ton per month if you have a higher volume of bookings. I don't think it's reasonable to pay this much for a reservation system at a higher volume. This 5 to 7 percent amounts to a much higher percent of the profit margin itself. For our business, we found that there are other products that cost way less and have similar or even better functionality.
